values: SAP SuccessFactors employee numbers compared with https://varenergisandbox.service-now.com on 07/08/2026, 12:35:56 (Europe/Oslo)

528 of 2001 SAP employee numbers have no exact match in Sandbox sys_user.employee_number. The HR Profile API cannot process these people until a corresponding ServiceNow user exists with the same employee number.

1. Confirm whether the missing SAP people are within the Entra ID provisioning scope.
2. Check whether their Entra accounts exist but employeeNumber is empty or mapped differently.
3. Confirm treatment of future hires, terminated workers, contractors, and non-person accounts.
4. Re-run this reconciliation after Entra synchronization before the HR Profile full load.
ServiceNow employee numbers not in SAP list

This report proves whether an exact employee-number match exists in the Sandbox sys_user table. It does not by itself identify the upstream root cause. The missing list must be reconciled with Entra ID provisioning logs and SuccessFactors worker status before assigning ownership.
